description: This file defines the interface for HDMI Input management within a device handling framework. It includes class declarations, constants, and method prototypes for managing HDMI input ports, video modes, EDID data, and related features.

classes.name: HdmiInput
classes.description: A singleton class that manages HDMI input ports, video modes, EDID data, and related functionalities.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of the HdmiInput class.

methods.name: getNumberOfInputs
methods.description: Returns the number of HDMI input ports.

methods.name: isPresented
methods.description: Checks if HDMI input is currently presented.

methods.name: isActivePort
methods.description: Checks if a specified port is active.

methods.name: getActivePort
methods.description: Returns the currently active HDMI port.

methods.name: isPortConnected
methods.description: Checks if a specified port is connected.

methods.name: selectPort
methods.description: Selects a specific HDMI port, optionally requesting audio mixing and setting video plane type.

methods.name: scaleVideo
methods.description: Scales the video output to specified dimensions.

methods.name: selectZoomMode
methods.description: Selects a zoom mode for HDMI input.

methods.name: pauseAudio
methods.description: Pauses the audio stream.

methods.name: resumeAudio
methods.description: Resumes the paused audio stream.

methods.name: getCurrentVideoMode
methods.description: Returns the current video mode as a string.

methods.name: getCurrentVideoModeObj
methods.description: Retrieves the current video resolution details.

methods.name: getEDIDBytesInfo
methods.description: Retrieves EDID bytes information for a specified HDMI port.

methods.name: getHDMISPDInfo
methods.description: Retrieves HDMI Stream Path Data (SPD) info.

methods.name: setEdidVersion
methods.description: Sets the EDID version for an HDMI port.

methods.name: getEdidVersion
methods.description: Gets the EDID version for an HDMI port.

methods.name: getHdmiALLMStatus
methods.description: Retrieves HDMI Automatic Low Latency Mode (ALLM) status.

methods.name: getSupportedGameFeatures
methods.description: Gets supported game features as a list of strings.

methods.name: getAVLatency
methods.description: Retrieves audio and video latency values.

methods.name: setEdid2AllmSupport
methods.description: Enables or disables EDID version 2 ALLM support for a port.

methods.name: getEdid2AllmSupport
methods.description: Checks if EDID version 2 ALLM support is enabled for a port.
